description:
Paid content for @jeepuk. Hit the open road with a wildlife photographer Charlie Hamilton James and his son as they head into the countryside for a weekend of adventure, discovery, and photography lessons. From getting the perfect shot of magnificent red kites in flight to exploring in the Jeep Compass, their journey becomes about more than the extraordinary photos they capture. The memories created and time spent together are the ultimate reward.
